# 🎮 Neon Tic-Tac-Toe

> A glowing, dark-neon themed Tic-Tac-Toe game for the browser with particle effects, scoreboard, undo, and a "Mystery Mode" twist. 100% client-side — no backend, no build step, no dependencies.

## ✨ Features

- **Neon dark theme** — glowing board, animated background particle canvas, victory particle burst
- **2-player local play** — X vs O on a classic 3×3 board
- **Scoreboard** — running X/O scores with neon avatars
- **Undo** — step back through move history
- **Mystery Mode** — checkbox-enabled twist that hides moves for extra challenge
- **Sound effects** — toggleable in-game sounds (Web Audio, no assets)
- **Move timer / progress bar** — visual turn indicator
- **Victory screen** — animated win overlay with "Play Again"

## 🛠 Tech Stack

- **HTML5** — semantic game structure (`HTML Structure & UI Elements.html`)
- **CSS3** — DarkNeon theme, glow effects, responsive layout (`CSS Styling with DarkNeon Theme.css`)
- **Vanilla JavaScript** — game engine: board state, win detection, move history, particles (`JavaScript Game Logic & Features.js`)
- **Google Fonts** — Orbitron (futuristic typeface)

## 🚀 Quick Start

No build, no install. Just open the page:

```bash
# Clone and open
git clone https://github.com/girishlade111/Tic-Tac-Toe-game.git
cd Tic-Tac-Toe-game
# open index.html in any modern browser
```

Or serve locally for the cleanest experience:

```bash
npx serve .
```

## 📁 Project Structure

```
Tic-Tac-Toe-game/
├── index.html                     # Deployable entry point (web-safe copy)
├── styles.css                     # Deployable copy of the DarkNeon CSS
├── game.js                        # Deployable copy of the game engine JS
├── HTML Structure & UI Elements.html   # Original HTML source
├── CSS Styling with DarkNeon Theme.css # Original stylesheet source
├── JavaScript Game Logic & Features.js  # Original game engine source
├── User Guide                     # Gameplay guide
├── LICENSE
└── README.md
```

The original sources (files with descriptive names) are kept as-is for reference;
`index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js` are the web-deployable copies served by GitHub Pages.

## 🌐 Deployment

Static site — deployed via **GitHub Pages** from the `main` branch root (`/`).
